- **`lumen/client.py:77-102`** — Non-idempotent POSTs (`batch_create`, `review`) are retried on 429/5xx. - **`lumen/models.py:12`** — `_dict` annotation `Mapping[str, Any] | dict[str, Any]` is redundant (`dict` is already a `Mapping`).
